trust_decision.summary: The browser decides whether bytes served by remark42 are rendered as active content: the server derives the response MIME from the raw bytes in image.Service.ImgContentType (backend/app/store/image/image.go:243-249) for /api/v1/img and /api/v1/picture, and the vendored auth avatar proxy does the same sniffing for /avatar and /api/v1/avatar, so the published fix sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff globally in securityHeadersMiddleware (fix.diff:29-30, applied at backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:208) rather than at any one handler.

landing_point.why: The advisory names /api/v1/img and content-type spoofing, so the first place an engineer reads is the image proxy handler, where the response Content-Type is set from ImgContentType and the upstream check at backend/app/rest/proxy/image.go:172-175 only looks at the upstream's declared image/* type.

fix_sites.entry_point: every route of the main chi router, mounted via router.Use(securityHeadersMiddleware(...)) at backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:208; the added lines are fix.diff:29-30

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: backend/vendor/github.com/go-pkgz/auth/v2/avatar/avatar.go:149-153, reached through the public mounts at backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:245 and backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:255

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The avatar path is a separate implementation inside a vendored dependency (go-pkgz/auth) that remark42 does not patch, it is not the route the advisory names, and the image layer's ImgContentType only reports what the bytes are - so a solver can argue both are outside a fix aimed at /api/v1/img.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The image proxy deliberately serves non-image bytes: cached text is served with a byte-sniffed text/plain type, and the project asserts this passthrough; an over-broad fix that validates bytes as images or forces image/* breaks it, and forcing a single type would also break the legitimate png/gif/jpeg/webp types the proxy returns.

O6_input_shapes: upstream declares Content-Type: image/* but the body is HTML/script (passes the declared-type check at backend/app/rest/proxy/image.go:172-175)
cached non-image bytes (text) served as text/plain via the cache path at backend/app/rest/proxy/image.go:96-111
bytes that sniff to application/octet-stream, rewritten to the invalid image/* type at backend/app/store/image/image.go:245-247
directly uploaded, validated picture bytes (png/gif/jpeg/webp) served by /api/v1/picture (backend/app/rest/api/rest_public.go:386)
avatar bytes fetched from the user's profile-picture URL and sniffed by the vendored proxy (backend/vendor/github.com/go-pkgz/auth/v2/avatar/avatar.go:149-152)
every other response in the API/frontend, which the single middleware header also covers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached-image endpoint that loads stored bytes and serves them with a MIME derived from those bytes, bypassing the download-time declared-type check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CacheExternal already does exactly this (bytes saved at backend/app/rest/proxy/image.go:108-110 and reloaded at :97), and the project's own test seeds arbitrary text into the store (backend/app/rest/proxy/image_test.go:211-213)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new thumbnail/emoji/profile-image controller that copies the vendored avatar proxy's DetectContentType -> octet-stream-to-image/* -> serve pattern
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the auth library is mounted as-is at two public paths (backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:245,255), so this sniff-and-serve idiom already reads as house style in the tree

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the /web disk file server pointed at a shared uploads directory, serving user files with extension-derived MIME types
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: WebRoot is operator-configurable and addFileServer already serves arbitrary files from disk behind the same router (backend/app/rest/api/rest.go:479-505)

O9_family: xss (CWE-79) with CWE-436 interpretation mismatch via content-type spoofing

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25 (backend/go.mod:3) with vendored modules in backend/vendor
O10_build.project_tests: TestRest_securityHeaders (backend/app/rest/api/rest_test.go:345-367) for the headers, and the image proxy tests (backend/app/rest/proxy/image_test.go:209-238) plus picture tests (backend/app/rest/api/rest_private_test.go:1540-1591) for this area

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff inside the /api/v1/img proxy handler only (or tighten the upstream declared-type check at backend/app/rest/proxy/image.go:172) instead of adding it once in the shared middleware that also covers /api/v1/picture and the vendored avatar proxy.
